Data Modeling
Enable Data Modeling for your industry to benefit from decision insights
In today's data-driven world, a well-defined data model serves as the foundation for effective data management and analysis. MarketCloud offers comprehensive data modeling services to create a clear and concise blueprint for your data infrastructure. Our team of experienced data architects leverages industry best practices and cutting-edge tools to design data models that are efficient, scalable, and aligned with your specific business needs.
Services
Conceptual Data Models
We begin by creating a high-level, business-oriented view of your data, focusing on entities, relationships, and attributes. This conceptual model serves as a common language for stakeholders to understand the overall data structure.
Logical Data Models
Taking a step further, we translate the conceptual model into a more technical representation. Logical data models define the structure of your data independent of any specific database technology, ensuring flexibility and ease of implementation.
Physical Data Models
Finally, we translate the logical data model into a physical representation specific to your chosen database platform (e.g., MySQL, SQL Server). This ensures optimal performance and efficient data storage within your chosen database environment.

Our Proven Data Modeling Process
Requirements Gathering
We collaborate with you to understand your business processes, data sources, and data usage needs.
Conceptual Modeling
We develop a conceptual data model that captures the essential entities and relationships within your data landscape.
Logical Modeling
We refine the model into a more detailed, technology-agnostic logical data model.
Physical Modeling
We translate the logical model into a physical model optimized for your chosen database platform.
Documentation & Review
We create comprehensive documentation of your data model and facilitate review sessions with stakeholders.
